source.source: HYG v4.4 (Hipparcos-Yale-Gliese Database, D. Nash / astronexus)

source.sentinelDistDoc: dist == 100000.0 marks an unmeasurable/negative Hipparcos parallax; rows with it are dropped, not shipped.
source.hipSentinelDoc: hip == 0 means the row has no Hipparcos catalogue number.

galacticFrame.source: Hipparcos Catalogue vol. 1 §1.5.3 (ESA SP-1200, 1997); J2000 galactic frame constants shared by astropy and SOFA

panorama.title: The Milky Way panorama
panorama.longitudeConvention: l = 0 at the column centre, increasing leftward (sky seen from inside)
panorama.latitudeConvention: b = +90 at row 0, -90 at the last row

catalogRegistration.role: retained source record only; the photograph is registered astrometrically and owns visible stars

pointSourcePresentation.positionSource: licensed ESO photographic local maxima; no Google catalogue bytes
pointSourcePresentation.qualification: native fixed-size catalogue behavior collapsed into the prepared cubemap; point positions and colors remain ESO-derived

sky.qualification: source-photographed full sky sampled in ICRF through the J2000 galactic frame and the anchor-registered panorama; the scene registration carries the Ganymede pole and epoch; Solar System objects in the mosaic are capture artefacts; no Sun is baked into the cubemap
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

analyticRadialFit.qualification: Least-squares fit to annular red-channel means from the bound native 128 by 128 Sun texture; fitted values only, no source pixels.

distanceScaling.qualification: The opaque photospheric core is projected from the IAU nominal solar radius and the object catalog's mean heliocentric distance. The retained glow profile remains a visual presentation; the distance is not epoch-specific.

provenance.source: VSOP87A heliocentric positions with IAU/WGCCRE rotation elements
provenance.qualification: Observed Ganymede Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: USGS Voyager/Galileo mosaic at a 1 km map grid. Original observations vary from about 400 m to 20 km per pixel. Gray grid marks documented missing imagery. Photographed terrain shading remains; added globe lighting is approximate.
controls.summary: Source detail ranges from 400 m to 20 km per pixel. Photographed shadows remain; the gray grid marks missing imagery.
controls.title: Global image mosaic

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: USGS color mosaic combines infrared, green and violet observations with sharper monochrome detail. The source is photometrically normalized and brightness matched. Monochrome remains at the poles, in missing color coverage, and across the source's 210–250° west sector whose red channel was synthesized. This is enhanced color, not natural color; source resolution and seams vary.
controls.summary: Infrared, green and violet bands add color to monochrome detail. Missing or synthesized color is left monochrome.
controls.title: Color mosaic

controls.label: Geology
controls.description: Twenty-three archived map symbols distinguish interpreted dark and light terrains, crater and basin materials. Colors are categorical display choices. The GIS combines palimpsest age classes under p; the view preserves that combined symbol. Gray grid marks areas without an unambiguous polygon. No measured relief is added.

legend.title: Geologic units
legend.meta: Symbols identify archived categories. Colors are chosen for this display.

controls.title: Global geologic map

controls.label: Oxygen signature
controls.description: Published reflectance ratio sensitive to the 577.3 nm molecular-oxygen feature in surface ice. This is neither oxygen concentration nor atmospheric density. Spectral slope, the adjacent instrument gap and residual night-to-night differences affect contrasts. Values below one are retained. Two-degree samples and seams remain visible; gray grid marks missing or withheld edges. Absolute subpixel registration is unresolved.
controls.summary: A 565/577.3 nm surface-ice oxygen signature, not oxygen concentration. These 2° samples have approximate registration. Gray grid marks missing or withheld data; joins between nights remain.
controls.title: Oxygen-sensitive visible reflectance ratio
